==Overview==
<div style="float: right; width: 250px;">{{CaptionedImage|file=Assembly Freeborn.png|caption=This title is appointed by the Freeborn Assembly|width=250px}}</div>
The Herb Tender of the Cerulean Balmhouse is an [[Imperial title]] responsible for overseeing the Cerulean Balmhouse in Fontargenta, Feroz. The motion to [[Construct Cerulean Balmhouse|construct]] the Cerulean Balmhouse was proposed by '''Rahma I Fontanilla I Guerra''' as the proxy [[Kahraman|Senator for Kahraman]] during the Spring Equinox 388YE, and drew on [[Forging_links#One_Link_at_a_Time|aid]] offered by Sumaash.
__NOTOC__
The title is a little bit of a mouthful; informally, the holder is sometimes referred to as ''Cerulean Herbtender''.

==Responsibilities==
The Herb Tender is responsible for ensuring the herbs produced are made available to the "Freeborn healers bloc". There is some expectation that the Herb Tender will ensure that either a [[The_Brass_Coast_culture_and_customs#Contracts|contract]] is made on the use of the herbs or that they receive an honest price for them.
==Powers==
===Bountiful Gardens===
The balmhouse produces 22 drams of [[cerulean mazzarine]] and five drams of [[true vervain]] each season for the Herb Tender.

==Appointment==
The Cerulean Herbtender is a national position appointed by the Synod. It is elected by [[judgement]] of the Freeborn [[Assembly#The_National_Assemblies|Assembly]]. 

The title can be held by any Freeborn citizen. The Herb Tender has tenure and serves until they die or step down. They can be [[revocation|revoked]] by the [[Assembly#General_Assembly|General Assembly]], the Brass Coast National Assembly, and by the [[Assembly#Assembly_of_the_Nine|Assembly of the Nine]].
